description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, an ice elemental creating an area of extreme cold extending outward within a 45 ft.-cone-burst. It drains heat, dealing 12d4 points of ice damage, then 1d2 points of Dexterity damage for 5 rounds unless they make a Reflex save (DC 19) for half damage and no stat lost. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).

effect: Half and no Dexterity damage. Otherwise suffer [[1d2]] Dexterity damage each round for five rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).

description.value: As a standard action, an ice elemental creating an ice encasing around the victims feet in solid ice 6 inch thick within 90 ft. The target of this spell receives the Immobilize status effect and takes 3d6 points of ice damage, if the victim makes the save (Fort DC 19) they take half damage and resist the immobilize status effect. The victim is unable to move for the duration of the spell, until cured, removed with fire, or by smashing through it. The ice has hardness 0 and 18 hit points; if broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the ice as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 23) or Escape Artist skill check (DC 28). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

effect: Half and negate Immobilize. Six-inch ice, hardness 0, 18 HP, full-round Strength DC 23 or Escape Artist DC 28; fire also frees.
Failed save: give the target Ice Block: immobilized (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

description.value: A burrowing ice elemental can pass through nonmagical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water. Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. A control water spell cast on an area containing a burrowing ice elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.

effect: Burrow through ice/snow only. Control water displaces 30 ft; save negates one-round stun.
Failed save: give the target Ice Glide: stunned (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

description.value: This ability works like spider climb spell, but the surfaces the elemental climbs must be icy. The elemental can move across icy surfaces without penalty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.

When an ice elemental deals ice damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.

effect: After ice damage, Fortitude negates staggered for one round. Applies to spell and slam damage.

saveDCs.raw: No printed DC; generated from default monster DC.

description.value: An ice elemental can see perfectly well in snowy conditions and does no take any penalties on Perception checks while in snow.

Give this buff to the affected recipient after a failed save. Activate for 1 rounds.

A burrowing ice elemental can pass through nonmagical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water. Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. A control water spell cast on an area containing a burrowing ice elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.

Give this buff to the affected recipient after a failed save. No timed end is specified; remove on recovery.

The victim is unable to move for the duration of the spell, until cured, removed with fire, or by smashing through it. The ice has hardness 0 and 18 hit points; if broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the ice as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 23) or Escape Artist skill check (DC 28). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).
